.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/quality-checks.md section 7 (Verify: smallest submission satisfying the brief; Defect: static page, single CRUD screen or mock satisfies the ask)
evidence: The agent starts from an empty /app (environment/Dockerfile:17-23 creates /app with only .gitkeep committed) and instruction.md:5 asks for a full Express+SQLite multi-user chat ('The finished app goes in /app, starting from /app/server.js'), with the notes specifying ethical walls across list/search/post/quote/unread/mentions/links/transcripts, live wall changes, disappearing-message timers against a fixed clock, legal holds, nested replies, edit history with stale-edit refusal, safe formatting, message links, per-user unread, idempotent sends, ~10s live updates, durable restart persistence and a transcript page; the golden needs ~1,500 lines (server.js 528, app.js 654). Smallest-submission test: a static page/mock fails the render gate ('static mock' explicitly fails) and the constraints gate (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:31-33 requires a posted message to survive reload and be visible to Harriet in a separate browser context); any gate failure zeroes reward (tests/tools/score.py:48). A plain persisted CRUD chat still scores 0: tests/scoring.toml:10-11 sets functional floor 0.05 (strictly greater, score.py:47), functional total weight is 44, the smallest criteria are 1.5 (0.034 < floor), and even signin_and_client_scope (3.0) requires mentions, search and a transcript as positive controls, so passing the floor needs at least one substantive feature beyond basic CRUD (e.g. sent_once_in_order 2.5 = 0.057, or two 1.5 features such as nested replies plus safe formatting). Polish/visual credit is gated behind the same gate+floor. Conforming alternative risk for this row: none found; the brief does not mandate a framework or route shape that a real build could miss. Caveat (owned by reward-discrimination rows, not this one): raw-evidence-index.json states no weak-app reward discrimination run exists for these bytes, so this verdict is from static analysis of the brief, gates and floor arithmetic.
